oracle_assumptions: Bloodletter replaces opponent LIFE LOSS only during your turn, not the underlying damage value.
Solphim replaces source-controlled NONCOMBAT DAMAGE to an opponent or their permanent; here only opponent damage is tested.
Damage ordinarily causes equivalent life loss before Bloodletter applies; prevention prevents damage and that downstream loss.
Abaddon X counts cumulative life lost by all opponents this turn and grants cascade only to qualifying hand casts during your turn.
Loyal Subordinate's beginning-of-combat three-life loss is direct life loss, not damage; controller must control commander.
Thermo-Alchemist source on opponent turn assumed controlled since earlier turn; tap activation is legal with no summoning sickness.
fixture: Exact source 99-card multiset from the unchanged physical selected M7 candidate, commander separate, every physical source in one of library/hand/battlefield/stack/graveyard/exile. Boltwave {R} and Ignus {2}{R} pay with distinct actual source basic lands; other permanents are explicit conditional established-board fixtures, not assumed early-game probabilities.
decision_relevance: Bloodletter and Solphim are in all five physical Abaddon lists. Their distinct damage/life-loss replacements alter threshold eligibility for a source-paid hand-cast Ignus and other actual cascade triggers. Prior 95 P0 tests did not directly exercise either replacement source.

cases.expected: Physically spend {R} from an untapped Mountain for Boltwave: three opponents each take 3 noncombat damage/lose 3 life, total Abaddon X=9 without doublers.
With source-present Solphim, each opponent receives 6 actual damage and loses 6 life, Abaddon X=18; Solphim is not a direct life-loss replacement.
With source-present Bloodletter and no Solphim during controller turn, each opponent takes 3 damage but loses 6 life; X=18, damage remains 3.
With both source-present distinct replacement effects during controller turn, Boltwave deals 6 damage and causes 12 life loss per opponent, X=36; each effect applies once.
Loyal Subordinate combat-start loss 3 each with Abaddon controlled becomes 6 each with Bloodletter; Solphim cannot double non-damage direct loss.
One opponent has a prevention shield for the entire Boltwave event, so despite both doublers this opponent loses 0; other opponents lose 12 each, total X=24.
Paid Boltwave countered before resolution stays in graveyard but deals no damage and generates no opponent loss; Abaddon X remains zero.

Existing Thermo-Alchemist may tap on an opponent's turn for source-controlled noncombat one damage each; Solphim makes 2 damage/loss each, Bloodletter off-turn does not replace, Abaddon grants no cascade.

After fully resolving doubled paid Boltwave, source-paid {2}{R} Grinning Ignus hand cast with three different previously untapped physical lands earns one granted Abaddon cascade at recorded X36; subsequently removing Bloodletter cannot undo that cast trigger.

budget.stop_rule: Run exactly nine independent deterministic conditional fixtures plus existing 95-name replay once; stop after named assertions and CI, no broad new simulation.

not_modeled: Opponent deck distribution or preventive enchantment prevalence
All 99 actual card effects or multiplayer outcome
Full mana-base probability and win rate
